bpmn2:process.studyflow:documentation: Step 1 of the example study: the design as a complete, runnable fragment, covering the enrolment and allocation phases of the CONSORT participant flow. The two lanes are the CONSORT phases they implement. A consented start event, a screening questionnaire carrying the audit checklist, an eligibility gateway whose criteria are attributes of the node, and a randomization gateway carrying its allocation rule. Every early exit is a counted error event; the runner writes the participant-flow counts onto these events at run time.
bpmn2:process.name: Step 1 - Design

bpmn2:task.studyflow:checklist: - [ ] Informed consent recorded - [ ] Demographic intake - [ ] Inclusion criteria checked - [ ] Exclusion criteria checked
bpmn2:task.name: Screening

cognitive:eligibilityGateway.cognitive:inclusionCriteria: Registered agent family with a pinned model version (artificial cohort)

bpmn2:exclusiveGateway.studyflow:documentation: Random allocation applies to the human cohort only; artificial agents run the full factorial, so path contrasts hold within a family. Time pressure is implemented per family: a response timeout for humans, a prompt deadline for language models.
bpmn2:exclusiveGateway.name: Randomized
